skills.description: This skill should be used when a product, marketing, or growth team is planning or executing a Product Hunt (PH) launch to gain overseas exposure. 评估产品是否适合冲榜：做完自检清单，直接告诉你“现在冲”还是“再等等”
自动生成物料清单和模板：Tagline、Description、First Comment 怎么写，直接给模板，不用从零憋
